text: CHECKER (infer.rs, all engines): a struct or Enum::Variant pattern's field binding is bound to the declared field type's skeleton (numeric leaves free vars that must resolve to a number, every other leaf exact); a generic field stays untyped. Check-clean run panics such as S::C { r } => r + 1 with r: str are E0102 ("use of pattern field r"). New refusals of programs that run: a field used as another kind where the value passed through (println of an i64 field, r == 1 on a str field, arms joining str and i64; NH-1 (a)). No interpreter or runtime change. The 717 tracked .ax files check with the same exit codes and diagnostics as the base binary.
